address: 30 Soi Athakravi 1, Rama 4 Road, Khlong Tan, Khlong Toei, Bangkok, 10110, Thailand
bio: Mia offers modern European cuisine with Asian influences in a contemporary two-storey house. Downstairs is a chic bar; upstairs offers three distinct dining rooms: one decked out in colourful William Morris wallpaper, one accented with bursts of tropical plants and flowers, and one dark and intimate. The seasonal ‘Taste of Mia’ menu shows off dishes with complex, well-balanced flavours and is served in 5 or 8 courses, with vegan and vegetarian options available....
